activity.notes: Minamoto no Yoshitsune was a historical Genji military commander whose decisive campaigns against the Taira are securely documented in 1184-1185. The National Theatre of Japan identifies his surprise attack at Ichi-no-Tani in 1184, his campaign at Yashima in 1185, and his command in the final naval battle at Dan-no-ura in 1185, which ended Taira power. ATLAS therefore records the tightly bounded 1184-1185 military-command phase under the higher-order Japan polity, reusing the existing Military Commander role. This Activity does not treat Yoshitsune as a sovereign ruler, and it does not extend his military chronology through his later conflict with Yoritomo and flight before his death in 1189.
